human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Review found that Ailuros now has two parallel decision-classification implementations: signals._evidence_inconsistency_rule hard-codes allow vs {block, fail, blocked, deny}, while post-run conformance uses the projection approval vocabularies {approved, approve, granted} and {denied, deny, rejected, reject, declined}. The same structured governance meaning can therefore be classified differently depending on which Ailuros surface evaluates it. Converge these paths on one small deterministic decision-disposition primitive and one shared token vocabulary. Preserve structured-only semantics: no free-text parsing, no missing->contradiction promotion, no new policy engine.
human_pressure.why_now: Pack 8096 was explicitly intended to repair validator/conformance semantic drift. Leaving signals and conformance with separate decision vocabularies recreates the same failure class one layer later. Governance surfaces must not disagree about the same structured decision token.
do_not_misread: Do not redesign DecisionSummary, ApprovalRecord or the governance event ontology.
Do not parse prose, stderr or inferred intent.
Do not add fuzzy matching or model-based classification.
Do not broaden runtime enforcement behavior; this pack aligns interpretation only.
red_lines: There must be one semantic classification primitive used by both signals-side inconsistency detection and conformance-side approval contradiction detection.
The shared vocabulary may contain only tokens already recognized by at least one of the two current implementations; do not invent new synonyms.
Unknown tokens remain unknown and never create a contradiction by themselves.
Equivalent structured evidence must yield equivalent approved/denied disposition across both paths.

machine_core.goal: Eliminate duplicated governance decision semantics by centralizing approved/denied classification and making signals and conformance consume the same deterministic primitive.
invariants: Approved-side shared tokens are exactly the union of currently recognized positive tokens: allow, approved, approve, granted.
Denied-side shared tokens are exactly the union of currently recognized negative tokens: block, fail, blocked, deny, denied, rejected, reject, declined.
Token normalization remains trim+lowercase for structured strings only.
Signals and conformance do not maintain separate approved/denied token sets after this pack.
No runtime enforcement outcome is changed merely because the classifier is shared.

producer.artifact: structured governance decision/approval decision tokens already consumed by projection, signals and evidence conformance

consumer.component: signals inconsistency detection and evidence conformance inconsistency detection

observable_effect.assertion: The same structured token maps to the same approved, denied or unknown disposition across Ailuros governance surfaces, using one shared classifier and one closed union of the previously recognized vocabularies.

proofs.assertion: allow, approved, approve and granted all classify approved wherever the shared classifier is used.
block, fail, blocked, deny, denied, rejected, reject and declined all classify denied wherever the shared classifier is used.
At least one token previously recognized only by signals and one previously recognized only by conformance now produce the same disposition in both paths.
An unrelated structured token remains unknown and does not create a contradiction.

failure_semantics: Unknown decision vocabulary remains unknown rather than guessed.
Missing structured fields remain missing rather than contradictory.
This semantic convergence does not authorize, deny or block runtime actions.

steps.title: Characterize semantic drift
details: Add tests proving at least one positive token and one negative token currently classify differently between signals and conformance paths.
Keep fixtures fully structured; no prose-based inputs.

steps.title: Create one shared disposition primitive
details: Place the smallest source-neutral helper in an existing neutral module; do not create a new semantic subsystem.
Return only approved, denied or unknown/unclassified using the exact union vocabulary in this pack.

steps.title: Replace duplicated classification
details: Make signals inconsistency detection and conformance approval contradiction detection call the shared primitive rather than maintaining local literal sets.
Reuse the same primitive from projection approval-state normalization where doing so removes duplication without changing public behavior.

steps.title: Lock unknown and non-inference boundaries
details: Verify unknown tokens remain unknown, booleans/non-strings do not become decisions, and missing fields do not become contradictions.

acceptance: Signals and evidence conformance no longer maintain separate decision token vocabularies.
The exact union token sets defined by this pack classify consistently across both surfaces.
Unknown tokens remain unknown and do not create false inconsistencies.
No free-text parsing, runtime enforcement or new policy abstraction is introduced.
ruff, mypy, focused tests and the full pytest suite pass.

must_check: One shared classifier/primitive is the source of approved/denied interpretation for both signals and conformance inconsistency paths.
The shared approved vocabulary is exactly allow, approved, approve, granted; the shared denied vocabulary is exactly block, fail, blocked, deny, denied, rejected, reject, declined.
Tokens previously unique to either path now classify identically across surfaces.
Unknown/missing/non-string values remain unclassified and do not create contradictions.
No runtime enforcement or free-text interpretation is added.
Focused tests, full pytest, ruff and mypy pass.
reject_if: Signals and conformance still contain independently maintained approved/denied literal sets.
New synonyms beyond the union of existing vocabularies are introduced.
Unknown or missing evidence is promoted into contradiction.
Free text, stderr or inferred intent is parsed to classify decisions.
A policy engine or runtime enforcement behavior is introduced.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Cross-surface convergence of structured governance decision disposition.
missing_targets: tests/test_governance_decision_semantics_consistency.py may be created by this pack
